en-US.description: access a Windows named pipe compatible with command-line tools and WSL
en-US.longDescription: npiperelay is a tool that allows you to access a Windows named pipe in a way that is more compatible with a variety of command-line tools. With it, you can use Windows named pipes from the Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL).
